newsitem.title: USA: Southern Mineral well is in production.
newsitem.headline: Southern Mineral well is in production.

text.p: Southern Mineral Corp said Tuesday the Lafourche Realty No. 7 well was placed on production on November 25 and is producing a sustained rate of 2.1 million cubic feet of natural gas and 169 barrels of condensate per day.
Southern said it owns a 93 percent working interest in the well which is producing from perforations in the LWR McGowan formation in the 15 foot interval between 13,535 feet and 13,550 feet.
The well is located in the Bayou Fer Blanc field in Lafourche Parish, La., and is operated by Diasu Oil & Gas Co Inc. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
